single_compatible_configuration.rationale: Use an already preregistered G24 head-tolerance level only because it satisfies the independently derived stopping bound; do not infer production authority from G24 itself.
single_compatible_configuration.provenance: G24 TIGHT_2 head values plus newly derived residual-flow bound

execution_contract: Run the same one-real-SWAP-column/one-MODFLOW-cell closeout fixture.
Change only IMS stopping controls to the preregistered compatible configuration.
Keep the 1e-15 m/s physical coupling residual criterion unchanged.
Keep the independent constant-flux MODFLOW q(H) endpoint oracle unchanged.
Require the oracle root itself to satisfy the 1e-15 m/s residual criterion, not a head-width surrogate.
Require native MODFLOW IN-OUT residual <= 4.32e-11 m3/day in addition to the already frozen model-budget gate.
Require binary API component agreement, SWAP mass closure, equal/opposite accepted transfer, rejected-trial zero authority, exactly-once publication, and stale-origin protection.
Repeat the compatible run in a fresh process and require identical accepted endpoint/transfer signatures.
Do not change tolerances or hypotheses after observing this execution.

decision_rules.QUALIFIED_STOPPING_COMPATIBILITY: All frozen physical, component, transaction, replay and newly derived stopping gates pass.
decision_rules.BLOCKED_STOPPING_COMPATIBILITY: Any frozen or derived gate fails under the preregistered compatible configuration.
